notes: v192: Nuclear salvo — confirm your first strike, then every click (or tap) on the map fires another ICBM straight away until you press Done or Esc, or the missiles or money run out; your view stays where you're aiming. Peace talks: when a leader offers reparations or demands them, press Counter and name your price (or pick 1.5×/2×/3×); they accept, meet you partway, give a final offer, or take offence if you push too far — how far they'll go depends on how the war is going, their treasury and their temperament. Subtitles no longer flicker when a leader replies quickly.
